lines.zh: 背甲压着沙地，一步一个深坑。
lines.en: My shell presses the sand; each step leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸慢慢挪，不赶时间。
lines.en: I creep along the shoreline; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 壳上挂着海藻，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Seaweed hangs on my shell and drops with every step.

lines.zh: 潮水退到哪里，我就走到哪里。
lines.en: Where the tide pulls back, I follow it out.

lines.zh: 这一身重甲，转身要花半刻钟。
lines.en: This armor of mine takes half an hour to turn.

lines.zh: 鞍带松了，我停下来等它收紧。
lines.en: A saddle strap slips; I halt until it tightens.

lines.zh: 绕开那些石头，壳角经不起磕。
lines.en: I skirt those rocks; my shell's rim chips easily.

lines.zh: 身后留一串脚印，浪一冲就没了。
lines.en: Waves erase the prints I leave behind.

lines.zh: 我不乱跑，只是随便走走。
lines.en: I do not bolt; I merely wander where I like.

lines.zh: 壳缝里灌进海水，凉得舒服。
lines.en: Seawater seeps into my shell seams, pleasantly cold.

lines.zh: 有人骑上来，我就慢下来一点。
lines.en: When someone climbs on, I slow a little more.

lines.zh: 海底的礁石我认得，别催我。
lines.en: I know the reef by heart; do not hurry me.

lines.zh: 两只鞍位都空着，背倒是不沉。
lines.en: Both saddle seats are empty, so my back feels light.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着贝壳，我踩过去听响。
lines.en: Shells buried in sand crunch under my feet.

lines.zh: 冰面滑，我的爪扣不住。
lines.en: The ice is slick; my claws cannot grip.

lines.zh: 壳底拖着碎冰，一路咯吱。
lines.en: Crushed ice scrapes along under my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里的箱子晃了晃，货没掉。
lines.en: The chest inside my shell shifts; nothing spills.

lines.zh: 我眯着眼，任浪花拍壳沿。
lines.en: I squint while the surf slaps my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 背上没人，正好晒晒海面。
lines.en: No rider on my back; good time to bask.

lines.zh: 壳缝里有只小蟹在爬。
lines.en: A small crab crawls through a seam in my shell.

lines.zh: 我呼一口气，喷出一小股水。
lines.en: I exhale and blow a thin jet of water.

lines.zh: 那些鞍扣我数过，一共三副。
lines.en: I have counted my saddle buckles: three sets.

lines.zh: 有人叫我名字，我懒得回头。
lines.en: Someone calls my name; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 海底静得能听见壳里空响。
lines.en: The deep is quiet enough to hear my hollow shell.

lines.zh: 苔藓长到眼边，我眨不掉。
lines.en: Moss has grown to my eyes and will not blink off.

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲一层压一层，像屋顶。
lines.en: My plates overlap like roof tiles.

lines.zh: 昨天那只箱子还在壳里，锁着。
lines.en: Yesterday's box is still locked inside me.

lines.zh: 我站定不动，让鱼群借我挡浪。
lines.en: I stand still so the fish can shelter behind me.

lines.zh: 甲壳兽不常叫，叫起来像船底擦礁。
lines.en: A Shellback rarely calls; it sounds like a keel on reef.

lines.zh: 我一半在沙里，一半在水里。
lines.en: Half of me is in the sand, half in the water.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: You stand too close; I cannot make out your face.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，先看你的鞍，不看人。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to your saddle, not to you.

lines.zh: 你的手别乱摸壳沿，会割伤。
lines.en: Keep your hands off my shell's edge; it cuts.

lines.zh: 就是你吗，说要骑我下海的那个。
lines.en: So you are the one who spoke of riding me down.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，才认出你是活人。
lines.en: I stare a long while before I decide you are alive.

lines.zh: 你身上有盐味，跟这片海一样。
lines.en: You smell of salt, the same as this sea.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，颈甲响了一声。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly; my neck plate clicks.

lines.zh: 别举火把，我不喜欢亮东西。
lines.en: Do not raise a torch; I dislike bright things.

lines.zh: 你脚下的沙在陷，往后站些。
lines.en: The sand sinks under you; step back a bit.

lines.zh: 我在看你的腰带，像条好绳子。
lines.en: I am eyeing your belt; it looks like good cord.

lines.zh: 你眼睛动得快，我盯得慢。
lines.en: Your eyes dart quickly; mine settle slowly.

lines.zh: 你把鞍放下来，我才认你是客人。
lines.en: Set the saddle down, and I will count you a guest.

lines.zh: 海雾里你的影子只有一条。
lines.en: In the fog your shadow shows only one shape.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上带了几只箱子。
lines.en: I am counting how many boxes you carry.

lines.zh: 你哈出的白气，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see the white breath you puff out.

lines.zh: 把鞍绳系紧，别让我回头找你。
lines.en: Tie the girth tight; do not make me come back for you.

lines.zh: 你在数我的壳纹做什么。
lines.en: Why are you counting the ridges on my shell?

lines.zh: 雪落在你肩上，别站太久。
lines.en: Snow is settling on your shoulders; do not linger.

lines.zh: 壳上多了道白痕，我记着。
lines.en: A white scar on my shell; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 疼倒不怕，我怕壳裂。
lines.en: Pain I can bear; a cracked shell I cannot.

lines.zh: 这一下打醒了我的火气。
lines.en: That blow has woken my temper.

lines.zh: 甲片翻起来一片，海水灌进去。
lines.en: A plate lifts and seawater seeps in.

lines.zh: 我的腿一软，身子歪了半寸。
lines.en: My leg gives and my body lists a hand's width.

lines.zh: 你们打壳，里面可住着人。
lines.en: You strike the shell, and there are riders inside.

lines.zh: 这伤要到退潮才缓得过来。
lines.en: This wound eases only when the tide goes out.

lines.zh: 我把头埋低，护住眼睛。
lines.en: I lower my head to guard my eyes.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，整片礁都在响。
lines.en: I grunt once, and the whole reef echoes.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢就不会还手。
lines.en: Do not think slow means I will not hit back.

lines.zh: 别拿鱼干逗我，我不追吃的。
lines.en: Do not wave dried fish at me; I do not chase food.

lines.zh: 你把鞍摆出来，我倒愿意低头。
lines.en: Show me the saddle and I might lower my head.

lines.zh: 一筐鱼换不到我背上的位置。
lines.en: A basket of fish will not buy a seat on my back.

lines.zh: 这不是饿，是你在哄我走。
lines.en: This is not hunger; it is you coaxing me along.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，是海带，不感兴趣。
lines.en: I sniff: kelp. I am not interested.

lines.zh: 你把箱子放我壳边，我就懂规矩。
lines.en: Put the box by my shell and I understand the deal.

lines.zh: 别晃手中的桶，我壳里已有水。
lines.en: Stop swinging that bucket; my shell already holds water.

lines.zh: 想让我走，就拉鞍带，不要喂。
lines.en: If you want me to move, pull the strap, not the food.

lines.zh: 我鼻子很钝，诱饵对我没用。
lines.en: My nose is dull; bait has no pull on me.

lines.zh: 你答应过给我一处阴凉，对吧。
lines.en: You promised me a patch of shade, did you not.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上我的壳，自己退开了。
lines.en: You bounce off my shell and stagger away.

lines.zh: 我这么重，撞上来的是你吃亏。
lines.en: I am this heavy; the collision hurts you.

lines.zh: 壳沿刮了你的袖子，我道不了歉。
lines.en: My shell's rim scraped your sleeve; I cannot apologize.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这身甲停不住。
lines.en: Make room, this armor does not stop quickly.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的脚印里，崴了脚。
lines.en: You stepped into my print and twisted your ankle.

lines.zh: 我不是要撞你，是转不过弯。
lines.en: I did not mean to hit you; I cannot turn that tight.

lines.zh: 海藻从我背上滑下来，盖了你一脚。
lines.en: Seaweed slides off my back onto your foot.

lines.zh: 你退后三步，我才好过去。
lines.en: Step back three paces so I can pass.

lines.zh: 壳与壳碰在一起，声音像钟。
lines.en: Shell against shell, we ring like a bell.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的侧面走，那里最硬。
lines.en: Do not walk along my flank; that is the hardest part.

lines.zh: 同类都在海底躺着，成了礁。
lines.en: My kin lie on the sea floor and have become reef.

lines.zh: 我这年纪，早不谈这些了。
lines.en: At my age, I no longer bother with such things.

lines.zh: 甲壳兽独来独往，壳就是伴。
lines.en: Shellbacks keep to themselves; the shell is company.

lines.zh: 谁靠近我背，我就当他要装货。
lines.en: Whoever nears my back, I assume they want to load cargo.

lines.zh: 海那么深，叫声传不到对面。
lines.en: The sea is so deep my call never reaches another.

lines.zh: 我背上有两只鞍位，没有伴侣。
lines.en: Two saddle seats on my back, and no mate.

lines.zh: 春天到了，我只想多晒一会。
lines.en: Spring is here, and I only want another hour of sun.

lines.zh: 我不追谁，也不等谁。
lines.en: I chase no one, and I wait for no one.

lines.zh: 蛋是别人替我捡的，我不管。
lines.en: Others gather my eggs; I take no part in it.

lines.zh: 海床上我最大的邻居是块石头。
lines.en: My largest neighbor on the seabed is a rock.

lines.zh: 东西放壳里，别塞进我嘴里。
lines.en: Put it in my shell, not into my mouth.

lines.zh: 这口箱子卡在壳缝，拿不出来。
lines.en: This box is wedged in my shell and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我只驮，不叼，牙口不好。
lines.en: I carry, I do not bite; my teeth are poor.

lines.zh: 你掉的那把镐，滚到我腹甲下了。
lines.en: The pickaxe you dropped rolled under my belly plate.

lines.zh: 壳里的东西是你装的，你记着。
lines.en: You packed what is in my shell; you keep count.

lines.zh: 别往我背上堆，鞍位压坏了。
lines.en: Stop piling onto my back; you will crush the saddles.

lines.zh: 我捡不起这枚硬币，脚太粗。
lines.en: I cannot pick up that coin; my feet are too broad.

lines.zh: 有东西落进壳里了，叮当一响。
lines.en: Something fell into my shell with a clink.

lines.zh: 你把货递给我，我只会背着走。
lines.en: Hand me the cargo; all I do is carry it.

lines.zh: 这块铁太沉，换个人抬吧。
lines.en: This iron is too heavy; find someone else to lift it.

lines.zh: 那股血味从礁后飘过来，我转过去了。
lines.en: That blood-smell drifts from behind the reef; I turn.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我的贝壳堆，我记住了。
lines.en: You crushed my shell pile; I remember it.

lines.zh: 谁在壳上刻了字，站出来。
lines.en: Whoever carved words on my shell, step forward.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，可我的体重够用。
lines.en: I am no hunter, but my weight will do.

lines.zh: 你手里那根钩子，冲我来的？
lines.en: That hook in your hand — is it meant for me?

lines.zh: 海面下有个影子一直跟着我。
lines.en: A shadow under the surface has been trailing me.

lines.zh: 有人撬我的鞍扣，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is prying my saddle buckles; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你退得太快，反而像要动手。
lines.en: You retreat too fast; it looks like an attack.

lines.zh: 我要先把你赶出这片礁盘。
lines.en: First I will push you off this reef shelf.

lines.zh: 这声音不像浪，像脚步。
lines.en: That is not surf; those are footsteps.

lines.zh: 壳里少了东西，我盯上你了。
lines.en: Something is missing from my shell, and I am watching you.

lines.zh: 别躲到石头后面，我闻得到盐。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the rocks; I smell your salt.

lines.zh: 你踩我尾巴了，这事没那么算了。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; this is not settled.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把壳正对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and square my shell at you.

lines.zh: 你踢了我的壳，声音很脆。
lines.en: You kicked my shell, and it rang sharply.

lines.zh: 冰窟窿边那个影子，是你吧。
lines.en: That shape by the ice hole, that is you.

lines.zh: 我压着步子，等你先动。
lines.en: I hold my pace and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 壳挡住了你的路，你绕不过去。
lines.en: My shell blocks your path; you will not get around.

lines.zh: 我不喊，只在雾里靠近。
lines.en: I do not shout; I close in through the fog.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就进半步。
lines.en: You step back; I take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 这身甲挪得慢，可方向不改。
lines.en: This armor moves slowly but never changes course.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚跟，不盯眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your heels, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 潮水在涨，你站的地方要没了。
lines.en: The tide rises; the ground you hold will vanish.

lines.zh: 我的影子压过来，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When my shadow falls over you, you should run.

lines.zh: 我不急，海底的时间很慢。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; time moves slowly down here.

lines.zh: 你听见壳磨沙的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the sound of shell grinding sand.

lines.zh: 我把退路用身体堵上了。
lines.en: I have blocked your way out with my body.

lines.zh: 鞍带在响，那是我在发力。
lines.en: The straps creak; that is me gathering force.

lines.zh: 距离再近一步，我就压下去。
lines.en: One step closer, and I will lean down.

lines.zh: 你别回头看，我会跟到岸边。
lines.en: Do not look back; I will follow to the shore.

lines.zh: 我绕着冰缝走，你退路不多。
lines.en: I circle the crevasse; you have few ways out.

lines.zh: 你踩上薄冰了，我听着裂声。
lines.en: You are on thin ice; I hear it cracking.

lines.zh: 我不用快，你冷得比我快。
lines.en: I need no speed; the cold will take you first.

lines.zh: 别往船骸里钻，那边我熟。
lines.en: Do not crawl into the wreck; I know it well.

lines.zh: 我侧身一撞，连人带盾都退了。
lines.en: I swing my flank; shield and all go back.

lines.zh: 壳沿横扫，沙子跟着飞起来。
lines.en: My shell's rim sweeps across, flinging sand.

lines.zh: 前甲压低，我整个人砸下去。
lines.en: I drop my front plate and slam down whole.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可你站不稳了。
lines.en: That was not heavy, yet you cannot stand.

lines.zh: 我用尾甲扫腿，你跪进沙里。
lines.en: My tail plate sweeps your legs; you kneel in sand.

lines.zh: 你打在我壳上，手先麻了。
lines.en: You strike my shell, and your hand goes numb first.

lines.zh: 我往前一顶，把你抵在礁上。
lines.en: I shove forward and pin you against the reef.

lines.zh: 甲缝里夹着你的衣角，扯不开。
lines.en: Your hem is caught in my plate seam and will not pull free.

lines.zh: 我不撕咬，只压，压到你不动。
lines.en: I do not bite; I press until you stop moving.

lines.zh: 浪替我推了一把，正合我意。
lines.en: The wave pushed for me, exactly as I wanted.

lines.zh: 这一撞带起的水花有两丈高。
lines.en: The splash from that blow rises two fathoms.

lines.zh: 你躲开第一次，躲不开第二次。
lines.en: Dodge the first; you will not dodge the second.

lines.zh: 我的角不长，可底下的劲大。
lines.en: My horn is short, but the force behind it is not.

lines.zh: 你听见闷响，那是壳落在你盾上。
lines.en: That dull crack was my shell on your shield.

lines.zh: 我压上冰面，裂缝跟着你走。
lines.en: I press down, and the cracks follow you.

lines.zh: 这一下顶在你膝上，不轻。
lines.en: This shove lands on your knee, and it is not gentle.

lines.zh: 我从沙里拱出来，壳上还挂着泥。
lines.en: I heave up out of the sand, mud still on my shell.

lines.zh: 这片海床空了很久，我来填上。
lines.en: This seabed has been empty long; I will fill it.

lines.zh: 潮声变了调，因为我到了。
lines.en: The surf changes tone because I have arrived.

lines.zh: 有人把我从刷怪蛋里倒了出来。
lines.en: Someone poured me out of a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 我第一次见光，就眯起了眼。
lines.en: My first sight of light makes me squint.

lines.zh: 深海压得我骨头发沉，正好。
lines.en: The deep's pressure weighs my bones; that suits me.

lines.zh: 四周的鱼都散了，我不在意。
lines.en: The fish scatter around me; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我一落地，沙就陷了半尺。
lines.en: When I land, the sand sinks a half foot.

lines.zh: 这片礁盘以后归我看着。
lines.en: I will keep watch over this reef shelf now.

lines.zh: 雾气里多了一个壳，就是我。
lines.en: A new shell in the fog — that is me.

lines.zh: 我身上带着海底的冷气。
lines.en: I carry the cold of the sea floor with me.

lines.zh: 出来第一件事，就是找块干的地方。
lines.en: First thing out, I look for dry ground.

lines.zh: 我的壳一响，周围都静了。
lines.en: When my shell creaks, everything else goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这水太浅，只够我站脚。
lines.en: This water is too shallow; it barely covers my feet.

lines.zh: 冰层下面憋久了，我钻上来。
lines.en: Cooped up under the ice too long, I break through.

lines.zh: 迷宫的拐角多了一个壳。
lines.en: One more shell now fills the maze corner.

lines.zh: 船骨上的霜抖落，我醒了。
lines.en: Frost slides off the ship ribs; I wake.

lines.zh: 这层冰面被我压出一圈纹。
lines.en: My bulk presses a ring of cracks into the ice.

lines.zh: 我带来海底的冷，站稳了。
lines.en: I bring the cold of the deep, and I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 沉船墓场又添了一头牲口。
lines.en: The ship graveyard has gained one more beast.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的壳，里头在响。
lines.en: Flame roasts my shell; it pops from inside.

lines.zh: 从礁上滑下来，壳磕掉一角。
lines.en: I slid off the reef and chipped my shell's corner.

lines.zh: 我沉下去了，壳里灌满了水。
lines.en: I am sinking, and my shell is filling.

lines.zh: 炸开的沙把我掀翻，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me, belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在甲缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my plate seam.

lines.zh: 紫色的符纹爬上壳面，发烫。
lines.en: Violet runes crawl across my shell, burning.

lines.zh: 我饿得很慢，壳先变轻。
lines.en: I starve slowly; my shell grows light first.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳顶，我全身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crown; I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 壳下没有底，我掉得太久。
lines.en: There is no floor beneath my shell; I fall too long.
